Sentence (English): I wonder if it is normal for Samsung to require the customer to adjust everything themselves for installation, contrary to the installation guide.
Comments (English): #SamsungElectronicsEventParticipation. The delivery and installation process was a bit disappointing. The pre-inspection team and the installation team seemed to be acting independently. The pre-inspection team scheduled the date too late, while the installation team contacted me 9 days prior saying they would deliver. Both teams were no-shows on the day without any notice. It was very frustrating because both sides kept changing the dates to the 20th, 22nd, 24th, 28th, and 31st. The pre-inspection team stated that installation is possible if the horizontal dimensions differ by less than 5mm, but not if they differ by more than 10mm, so they asked me to hammer wooden boards into both walls beforehand to match the dimensions. They also asked me to prepare a longer drain pipe to replace the short pipe, even though the drain is located right next to it. I wonder if it is normal for Samsung to require the customer to adjust everything themselves for installation, contrary to the installation guide. This is my first time using the product, and I am satisfied because it cleaned thoroughly without any gaps. The product's design is stylish, so it matches my kitchen interior well.

Comments (English): #SamsungElectronicsEventParticipation. I had always hesitated to buy a dishwasher but never got around to it, but I was finally able to replace mine thanks to this great opportunity. Both the pre-refurbishment technician and the installation technician were kind and thorough, and I am very satisfied with how it looks. Since my base cabinet is white, the color is Cotta White, but it doesn't stand out; it is subtle and blends in well. I still need to get the hang of stacking dishes inside the dishwasher, but even when I put quite a lot in, everything gets cleaned thoroughly. I should have bought this sooner. As a family of two, I pre-wash and put the dishes in, then gather them up to run the cycle. Pre-rinsing is quick, so it isn't a hassle, and I love that there is no visible pile of dishwashing in the sink. It gives me peace of mind knowing that it will be cleaner than washing by hand. I feel even more at ease knowing that it is equipped with a filter. + I filmed a video, but it won't upload.

First of all, since it's built-in, the kitchen looks much cleaner and prettier. I've been using it for a little over a month now. At first, I was really stressed about stains. Since cleaning power is better if you pack them without overlapping as much as possible, I definitely recommend getting the large size! It's so incredibly convenient—I just rinse them roughly to remove any solid food, put them in, add detergent, and run it—and that's it! Why did I wait so long to buy this? The AI custom wash function is also fantastic. It automatically detects the level of dirt on the dishes and adjusts the time accordingly. It saves time and is a very smart device. If you use rinse aid and the hot air drying function, almost no water stains remain, and if you leave the lid open, the dishes dry perfectly and stay fluffy! First of all, I was even more satisfied because there is almost no noise, much quieter than I expected. I was watching TV in the living room with the dishwasher running, and it felt so quiet that I couldn't even tell it was working. It does take longer than hand washing, and I am a little worried about the electricity bill, but since it is an appliance I use every day... I believe this product improves my quality of life. It often feels like I’m going to work again right after coming home from work, but this little guy is like a ray of light—something I’m truly grateful for. I want to take good care of it so I can use it for a long time. If you’re considering buying it, I highly recommend you do so! If my review helped you with your purchase, please click [Helpful]. Have a great day!

Sentence (English): Since our children are all grown up and it is just my wife and me living here, we don't generate much tableware.
Comments (English): Since our children are all grown up and it is just my wife and me living here, we don't generate much tableware. So, I used the excuse of buying a birthday present to time my purchase (or rather, giving her a gift?) for her birthday. Initially, I planned to buy a built-in model, but after looking into it closely, I realized it would require using two cabinet doors and the renovations seemed like a hassle. Most importantly, I worried my back would hurt from "Tetrising" (loading the dishes), so I opted for a shelf-top model instead. First off, it’s great not having to bend over, and it’s truly wonderful that my wife no longer gets annoyed by the dishes scattered around the sink when we get home. The cleaning performance is excellent; perhaps because it washes at high temperatures, the dishes come out squeaky clean. Also, if you rinse off food residue with water before putting them in and running the cycle, even grease gets cleaned thoroughly, making it convenient for me—a man in his 50s—to use. Furthermore, since it only has a single tier, you just need to fit everything in there; it’s perfect for two people, and actually makes "Tetrising" easier. In many ways, I think I made the right choice going with this one.
Comments (Original): 저희는 자녀가 다 성장하여 와이프와 둘만 사는 집이라 식기류는 많이 나오지 안아서 와이프 생일에 맞춰 생일선물 핑계대고 6인용 식기세척기를 구매(선물?)했습니다. 초기엔 빌트인을 사려고 했으나, 자세히 알아보니 씽크 하부 문 두짝을 사용해야 하고 공사도 번거로울거 같고... 무엇보다도 테트리스(식기넣기) 할때 허리가 아플꺼 같아서 그냥 상부에 올려 놓는 모델을 구매했습니다. 일단 허리 굽힐일 없어서 좋고 집에 돌아와 씽크대에 널부러져 있는 설거지 거리의 와이프 짜증이 없어져서 정말 좋습니다.세정 상태도 고온으로 세척을 해서 그런지 뽀드득 합니다. ㅎㅎㅎ또한, 처음에 식기에 묻은 음식찌꺼기를 물에 살짝 흘려 보내고 세척기에 넣어서 돌리면 기름때도 깔끔하게 설거지가 되어서 50대 남자인 제가 쓰기에도 편리하더라구요.  그리고 1단만 있어서 거기에 맞게 집어 넣고 사용하면 되기에 둘이쓰기엔 딱이고 테트리스 하기도 1단이라 오히려 쉽습니다.여러모로 이놈으로 하길 잘한거 같습니다.

Sentence (English): 2026 Back Pain Relief Dishwasher!
Comments (English): #SamsungElectronicsEventParticipation. 2026 Back Pain Relief Dishwasher! I have suffered from a herniated disc for over 10 years. Washing dishes was the most burdensome task every evening as I wrapped up my day. When I consulted with a professor from the Department of Rehabilitation Medicine at Seoul National University Hospital, he explained that bending over at the sink to wash dishes is one of the postures that puts the most strain on the back in daily life, and recommended using a dishwasher to significantly reduce the burden on my back. Since built-in models require bending over, I compared various brands of products that sit on the countertop. I chose this Samsung model because it received the highest satisfaction ratings when considering price, design, and washing performance comprehensively. There is a video on KBS News showing a performance test conducted with the Consumer Protection Agency, and the results were overwhelming. The installation was also very satisfactory. The technician visited right on time, and the installation only took about 20 minutes. They carefully considered my preferences regarding the installation direction and adjusted it accordingly, and the finishing touches were truly impeccable. They kindly explained how to use it and even included detergent as a gift, making it a very pleasant experience. After using it for about a week, my quality of life has truly changed. It fits much more dishes than I expected, so I can put all the dishes I used throughout the day in at once after dinner and just press a button. Since it automatically completes both washing and drying, the stress of having to do the dishes has completely disappeared. In particular, since I hardly have to bend over anymore, I feel that for those like me with herniated discs or chronic back pain, this is not just a simple appliance, but a product that protects my health. The cleaning power is perfect, and the drying is clean, so I am extremely satisfied. The design actually makes the kitchen look more sophisticated, so I am pleased every time I look at it. Above all, what I am most grateful for is that I feel less physically exhausted when I finish the day. In the past, my back would ache first after finishing the dishes, but now, with just the press of a button, that time has become my time to relax. I am so satisfied after using it myself that I plan to buy one as a birthday gift for my mom and sister, who have never used a dishwasher before. I highly recommend it to those exhausted from childcare or work who find housework difficult due to back pain. It is not just an appliance that saves time; it makes your daily life much more comfortable and is a longevity item for a strong back that will last until you are 100.

Sentence (English): I've been using it for about three days, but the white water stains are quite severe.
Comments (English): I've been using it for about three days, but the white water stains are quite severe. As you can see in the picture, white marks appeared on the frying pan, so I ran that one again without detergent, but it's still the same. I wonder if the detergent is the problem. I think I'll have to buy some rinse aid and try using it. The dishwasher I used before had no issues, so I don't know why this is happening. I used to use an SK Magic dishwasher, but it suddenly broke down, so I had to urgently look for a new one. Since we are a family of three, I was looking for a product with a decent capacity that wouldn't take up too much kitchen space, so I decided on the Samsung Bespoke Countertop 6-place setting. I was hesitant about the construction work for a built-in model, so the countertop type was perfect. I also thought the white color would match the kitchen interior well. A technician visited my home for the installation; he was very kind, explained everything well, and neatly finished the water supply and drainage connections, so the process went much more smoothly than I had expected. After using it, I was surprised by how spacious the capacity is. The previous model had a two-tier structure, so I could load dishes both above and below, but this one is single-tier, so arranging them was a bit inconvenient at first. Even so, if I arranged the dishes skillfully, it fit enough for a meal for a family of three without any trouble. The automatic door opening feature was convenient because it opened automatically after the wash cycle finished, so I didn't have to open it manually. It also felt like steam and odors escaped naturally. However, since this model lacks a hot air drying function, while the dishes wash thoroughly, they don't dry completely fluffy; sometimes there is a slight moisture left after taking them out, so I use it with that in mind. Nevertheless, overall, there were more satisfying aspects. Just the fact that I don't have to do hand washing has made my evenings much more relaxed, and thanks to the automatic door opening feature, I feel a sense of convenience every time I use it. Compared to when I used an SK Magic washing machine, it took a little time to get used to the single-tier structure, but once I learned how to arrange the dishes, it wasn't a major inconvenience. Except for the lack of hot air drying, I am generally satisfied and using it well. Key Points: Visited installation by a technician; satisfied with the installation process due to friendly explanations and neat finishing. Sufficient capacity even for a family of three, but arrangement requires some skill due to the single-tier structure. No hassle of opening the door after washing thanks to the automatic door opening feature. Sentence (English): At first, I kept putting off buying a dishwasher because I wondered if it was really necessary.
Comments (English): [ Buy it instead of worrying ] || ---------------- || At first, I kept putting off buying a dishwasher because I wondered if it was really necessary. There is a reason why people say that "a dishwasher is an appliance that changes your quality of life." I highly recommend it to anyone who finds washing dishes a hassle or wants to save even a little time after a meal. If you have been hesitating like I did, you might regret not buying it sooner, as the satisfaction level is that high.

Sentence (English): It's finally here!
Comments (English): It's finally here! It's been a month and a half since I received the dishwasher, so I was really curious to see just how good it was. The day before, the renovation company came to cut the baseboards and do some other renovations, and as soon as it was installed the next day, I put everything in and ran a test run. I threw in greasy pots, frying pans, spatulas, burnt-on bowls, spoons, chopsticks, and everything else and started it. I set it to standard and it showed 3 hours and 50 minutes, so I wondered if that was too long, but it actually only washed dishes for about 1 hour and 10 minutes, and the rest was just the door opening for drying. After the dishwasher finished, I touched the greasy pot, and wow! It was cleaner than when I washed it myself, and the grease was completely gone! The bowls were spotless, too. It's amazing. I don't think I'll ever get a sore wrist from washing dishes, and it saves time—I love it!

Sentence (English): We purchased this a month ago, so far so good.
Comments (English): [ Large capacity and 3rd rack is the best ] || ---------------- || We purchased this a month ago, so far so good. It does clean well and has a ton of space. I wanted a 3rd rack that was not just meant for silverware or utensils. I did a ton of research. It dries well, with exception to coffee lids. But those have areas that water will sit in. So, I am not upset by this in the least. I do prewash before things go in the dishwasher. It is not as quite as I expected, but not loud. I know when it is running if in the kitchen. I can hear the water swishing and a bit of a hum. The racks slide very smoothly and feel more sturdy than other models and brands I looked it. I did not want a handle because we prep most food in front of dishwasher. Costo was not able to install the unit when they arrived because our water line shut off is not under the sink and not up to code. We called out a separate plumber to install. I did call Costco afterwards to see if they could pick up the old Bosch dishwasher and they sent someone out a few days later. Customer service was great.

Please advise.

Sentence (English): The dishwasher washes well, and is quiet, and looks great.
Comments (English): [ Good dishwasher - a few problems ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher washes well, and is quiet, and looks great. The issues that took 2 stars off (1 star each issue) are:. 1 - the virtual "buttons" on the top, are too easy to press. Simply putting my hand on the top to close the front door is sometimes enough to accidentally activate the power button. I would like to have physical buttons, and for them to be either on the front, or off to the side of the stop. Off to the side would be where your hand typically won't touch/activate them. 2 - second issue is with the silverware drawer. It can be a little jerky when pulling out or pushing in. I don't know if we just got a bad one, but it feels like the tray/drawer may be misaligned rails that causes it to go in/out at a slight angle and does not slide smoothly. Also the silveryware divider can be moved up or down to produce more slots for silverware. There are two of these, the one of the right is nice and firm - stays in place The one of the left is lose and will easily fall down causing the silverware to not stand/stay in place.

Sentence (English): I had been debating whether or not to buy a dishwasher since moving in 8 years ago.
Comments (English): [ Good! A holy grail item ] || ---------------- || I had been debating whether or not to buy a dishwasher since moving in 8 years ago. While everyone around me was getting one, I kept hesitating and finally made a purchase recently. I actually bought it at a much lower price than when it first came out, and since delivery was fast and the installation technician was kind, I was truly satisfied right from the start. This is an honest review after using it for about 3 months since purchasing it in May. Initially, I used my existing ceramic soup and rice bowls, but for a family of 5, all 10 soup and rice bowls didn't fit in the middle of the second tier. So, taking into account what existing users said about the * brand* dishes being thin and easy to stack up, I additionally purchased * brand* side plates and cold noodle bowls. Now, we eat rice on the side plates and rice bowls or ramen in the cold noodle bowls, which is much more efficient. If I stack plates and bowls neatly on both sides of the basket in the bottom tier, it is sufficient to wash all the dishes for a family of 5's lunch and dinner in one go. I will also explain the difference between the 12-place and 14-place models, which many people are curious about. Although there is almost no difference in size, the 14-place model has plate racks on the bottom shelf that are spaced closer together, allowing you to fit more plates. The 12-place model, on the other hand, has slightly wider spacing, making it feel more comfortable for storing ceramic dishes. As a family of five, we tend to generate a lot of dishes at once—including soup bowls, rice bowls, plates, frozen food containers, and even plastic items—so I am very satisfied with choosing the 14-place model. Since it is during school vacation, I gathered all the dishes used for the kids' lunch and dinner after work to capture the actual usage exactly as it is. If you are someone who has been deliberating on a dishwasher for a long time like I was, I hope my review will be of some help to you.

So, taking into account what existing users said about the * brand* dishes being thin and easy to stack up, I additionally purchased * brand* side plates and cold noodle bowls. Now, we eat rice on the side plates and rice bowls or ramen in the cold noodle bowls, which is much more efficient. If I stack plates and bowls neatly on both sides of the basket in the bottom tier, it is sufficient to wash all the dishes for a family of 5's lunch and dinner in one go. I will also explain the difference between the 12-place and 14-place models, which many people are curious about. Although there is almost no difference in size, the 14-place model has plate racks on the bottom shelf that are spaced closer together, allowing you to fit more plates. The 12-place model, on the other hand, has slightly wider spacing, making it feel more comfortable for storing ceramic dishes. As a family of five, we tend to generate a lot of dishes at once—including soup bowls, rice bowls, plates, frozen food containers, and even plastic items—so I am very satisfied with choosing the 14-place model. Sentence (English): My old SK Magic dishwasher was showing a leak error, so I was looking for a replacement.
Comments (English): My old SK Magic dishwasher was showing a leak error, so I was looking for a replacement. Since it was during the Appreciation Festival, I was able to buy this at a great price. I tried using the AI custom setting, but perhaps because the wash temperature is low, the dishes don't dry very well. My old dishwasher had a rinse temperature of over 70 degrees, so most of the water would be removed after about 5 hours; this is a bit disappointing. The advantage is that the space is large, so I can fit a lot of dishes, large pots, and frying pans, and I only need to use it once a day, which is great. Sentence (English): I had to replace my old 18 year old Bosch dishwasher.
Comments (English): I had to replace my old 18 year old Bosch dishwasher. I chose the KitchenAid since it would match my other appliances. I like the new dishwasher OK. It has a lot of room and cleans the dishes well. It is so quiet my husband didn't think it was running. I only have one complaint. The tines in the bottom rack of the dishwasher are so far apart the plates lean over too far. Then the rack slides so smoothly that i almost sling the plates out the back of the dishwasher. If i was using pottery instead of my good Spode china I would have broken/chipped the plates. Otherwise, I am well pleased and plan to purchase this same model for our new house.

The tines in the bottom rack of the dishwasher are so far apart the plates lean over too far. Then the rack slides so smoothly that i almost sling the plates out the back of the dishwasher. If i was using pottery instead of my good Spode china I would have broken/chipped the plates. Otherwise, I am well pleased and plan to purchase this same model for our new house.

Sentence (English): I'm naturally a penny-pincher, so I agonized over the very idea of buying a dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Hesitation only delays delivery, so please get it quickly! ] || ---------------- || I'm naturally a penny-pincher, so I agonized over the very idea of buying a dishwasher. Even after deciding to buy it, I waited for a sale to get it at a slightly lower price. On top of that, I received a cashback benefit, so I ended up getting it for a much cheaper price. The conclusion is that buying it as soon as possible was the answer. I finally understand why everyone was raving about buying a dishwasher. My father-in-law bought one first and highly recommended this model, so I followed suit and bought the exact same one. I compared the specs with other models, and while the price difference wasn't significant, this one had far more useful features for actual use. The slide rack, the interior light that illuminates when you open it, the clean and intuitive interior display, and the frying pan rack that makes it easy to store large utensils—the additional features are packed in. In particular, I run my child's dishes and bottles all at once, and they always come out squeaky clean and sanitized, looking brand new. I can never go back to the days without a dishwasher. Instead of wasting time worrying, I highly recommend just buying it as soon as possible, even if it's just one day earlier. Sentence (English): I decided to replace my old built-in dishwasher, which I had used for about 10 years, after it broke down.
Comments (English): [ I can't live without a dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I decided to replace my old built-in dishwasher, which I had used for about 10 years, after it broke down. Since I live in an older apartment building, my biggest concern was whether installation would even be possible. However, after placing the order, an installation technician visited first to thoroughly check for the feasibility of a built-in installation. They explained that the baseboards would need to be cut to fit the new unit after the old one was removed, and the technician visited again later to complete the installation neatly. The systematic installation process gave me confidence, and I was satisfied with the finish. After using it, I understood why dishwashers are considered such high-quality appliances. There are various cycles available, so I tried a few different ones, but the 'Powerful Cycle + Extra Rinse' combination worked best for my home. When running with this setting, there are almost no water stains left on the dishes, and even greasy dishes are cleaned thoroughly. The technician explained that the degree of water staining might vary slightly depending on the limescale levels and water quality of each home, but I am satisfied with this cycle. I am currently using Frosh tablets; for the 12-place setting, even after filling the dishwasher to the brim, using just a quarter of a tablet provides sufficient cleaning power. I am very satisfied because it saves on detergent and cleans well. Above all, I really like the automatic door opening feature. When the wash is finished, the door opens automatically to let internal moisture escape, which dries the dishes much better and seems to reduce musty odors. It was also much more convenient to take out the dishes because they were nice and dry. The interior is made of stainless steel, so it is easy to maintain hygienically, and cleaning is not difficult as the filter and spray blades are easy to detach. The noise level is also quieter than expected, so it wasn't bothersome even when running it in the evening. Overall, I am very satisfied from installation to usage, and I would recommend this product to anyone considering replacing an old dishwasher.

Comments (English): [ I can't live without a dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I decided to replace my old built-in dishwasher, which I had used for about 10 years, after it broke down. Since I live in an older apartment building, my biggest concern was whether installation would even be possible. They explained that the baseboards would need to be cut to fit the new unit after the old one was removed, and the technician visited again later to complete the installation neatly. The systematic installation process gave me confidence, and I was satisfied with the finish. After using it, I understood why dishwashers are considered such high-quality appliances. There are various cycles available, so I tried a few different ones, but the 'Powerful Cycle + Extra Rinse' combination worked best for my home. When running with this setting, there are almost no water stains left on the dishes, and even greasy dishes are cleaned thoroughly. The technician explained that the degree of water staining might vary slightly depending on the limescale levels and water quality of each home, but I am satisfied with this cycle. I am currently using Frosh tablets; for the 12-place setting, even after filling the dishwasher to the brim, using just a quarter of a tablet provides sufficient cleaning power. I am very satisfied because it saves on detergent and cleans well. Above all, I really like the automatic door opening feature. When the wash is finished, the door opens automatically to let internal moisture escape, which dries the dishes much better and seems to reduce musty odors. It was also much more convenient to take out the dishes because they were nice and dry. The interior is made of stainless steel, so it is easy to maintain hygienically, and cleaning is not difficult as the filter and spray blades are easy to detach. The noise level is also quieter than expected, so it wasn't bothersome even when running it in the evening. Overall, I am very satisfied from installation to usage, and I would recommend this product to anyone considering replacing an old dishwasher.

Sentence (English): I ordered during a Samsung promotion, so I had to wait almost a month to receive and have it installed.
Comments (English): [ It really is improving my quality of life. ] || ---------------- || I ordered during a Samsung promotion, so I had to wait almost a month to receive and have it installed. I hesitated when I first bought it, but Coupang had the most reasonable price. So, I ordered it that very day, received a call a few days later, and they made a schedule and arrived exactly on that day. Knowing they were working hard in the heat, I told Samsung that I was satisfied with everything, but there were actually a few things I found disappointing. First, there is a compartment on the inside that folds, but no matter how I tried to stand it up, it kept tipping over. I wondered if it was defective and if I should just use it lying down. Today, after a week, I completely removed the container to look closely and discovered there was a place to secure it. I wish the technician had told me about that before leaving. I don't think it was mentioned in the manual. Also, as shown in the photo, I attached the water supply hose to the detergent container slot. After about three days, the part where they finished it started coming off. I am wondering how to neatly seal this part again. I don't want to contact the technician again to ask about it, as I think it might cause them some stress. Anyway, washing dishes has become much easier, and it works well. I live in a household of three, and I cleaned twice a day in one sitting, which was more than enough. At first, I was really worried about how much time to space out the cleaning, but as I kept at it, I got the hang of it, and it cleans incredibly well. I was even more satisfied than when I used to clean it myself. I'm sure my quality of life will improve as I continue to use it.
Comments (Original): [ 제 삶의 질을 올려주는거 맞네요^^ ] || ---------------- || 삼성에서 이벤트 하는 기간에 주문 하는 바람에 거의 한 달을 기다렸다가 받고 설치를 했습니다. 처음에 구매 할 때 망설였는데 쿠팡이 가장 가격이 합리적이었어요. 그래서 그날 바로 주문 하고 며칠뒤 연락을 받고 스케줄표를 짜서 그날 정확하게 오셨어요. 더운데 고생 하시는 거 알기 때문에 삼성에서 온 연락에는 모든 게 만족스럽다고 했는데, 사실 아쉬운 점도 조금 있었습니다.우선 안쪽 면에 폴더가 되는 칸이 있는데 그게 아무리 세워도 자꾸만 넘어지더라구요. 그래서 불량인가 눕혀서 그냥 써야 하나 생각해 보고 오늘 일주일 만에 아예통을 빼서 자세히 들여다 보니 고정되는 데가  있더라구요. 그런 거 기사님이 알려 주고 가셨으면 좋았을 걸 하는 아쉬움이 있었습니다. 설명서에도 나와있지 않았던 거 같아요. 그리고 사진에서처럼 저는 세제통 자리에 급수호수를 끼웠는데요. 3일 쯤 지나고 나서 부터 저렇게 마무리 해 주신 부분이 떨어지더라구요.이런 부분은 어떻게 깔끔하게 다시 막을지 고민이 됩니다. 기사님한테 다시 연락해서 묻고 싶지는 않구요. 그러면 신경 쓰실 것 같아서 아무튼 설거지는 너무 편해졌고 잘 작동 합니다. 저는 삼인 가구에 하루에 2번 몰아서 했는데 충분히 됐고 처음에는 어느 정도 간격을 둬야 할지 엄청 고민했는데 하다 보니 요령이 생겼고 너무 깨끗하게 잘 닦인다는 거죠. 제가 하는 것보다 더 만족스러웠습니다 앞으로도 더 잘 사용하다 보면 제 삶의 질이 더 올라 가겠죠.^^

Sentence (English): I used a Klim 6-place dishwasher a long time ago, but because the operation time was long, I didn't use it often and thought I would never get another one.
Comments (English): [ I'm using it well. ] || ---------------- || I used a Klim 6-place dishwasher a long time ago, but because the operation time was long, I didn't use it often and thought I would never get another one. My son must have really hated doing the dishes, even though it was just once in a while. He pestered me relentlessly. I figured, "Okay, let's just pretend we had a big meal out this one time," so I looked into various options. A 12-place built-in model seemed like it would be a hassle to bend over and straighten up while getting water dripping everywhere. After reading reviews about strong steam and food odors after washing, I searched for a 6-place model again, but since I didn't think I would use that one much either, I ended up buying this one because it was reasonably priced. I bought it because a special offer popped up. I hesitated a bit because it was full of reviews from trial groups. The sink was already pre-drilled, so there were no extra costs, and installation took only about 10 minutes. It is larger than the 6-place dishwasher I used before. As a result, it holds quite a lot of dishes. It is easy to fit large plates or noodle bowls. I had ruled out dishwashers with two shelves because of this feature. However, to store cups like in the product image, only mini cups under 7cm in height fit. That must be why it was labeled as a coffee cup. I tried running it with the dishwasher detergent I had bought in advance. It cleaned the dishes better than I expected. Occasionally, there is a trace of red spaghetti stain on the dishes and half a grain of rice stuck to the spatula, but that’s not a big deal. However, a lot of water remains after washing. Much more than in my old dishwasher. I wonder if it’s due to the water temperature or because it’s a low-cost model. I open the door, remove the tray, and let it dry. I only need to wash pots and pans. Even considering the need for pre-washing, I am satisfied with using the dishwasher.

It was very convenient to be able to check the progress on my smartphone even while out and receive notifications when the wash is finished. Now, I don't have to worry even if I start washing dishes and go out to do other things. It made me realize that this is what a smart appliance is all about. I thought installation might be tricky since it is a built-in product, but I felt relieved because the experienced technician handled the work very skillfully. The time saved allows me to spend more time with my family, and the stress of washing dishes has been significantly reduced. I am also very satisfied because the high-temperature washing with hot water gives me peace of mind regarding hygiene. I highly recommend this product, especially to families with young children, dual-income couples, and those who cook frequently. The Samsung BESPOKE AI Dishwasher (14-place setting) satisfied me in every aspect, from design and cleaning power to drying performance, low noise, AI features, and ease of use. Above all, the professional and friendly service from the installation technician added to the experience, making it a pleasant purchasing experience from start to finish. The elegance of my kitchen has been elevated, and the daily routine of washing dishes has transformed into relaxing time spent with my family. This purchase was a choice I truly have no regrets about, and I would confidently recommend the Samsung BESPOKE AI Dishwasher to anyone around me who is considering buying one. I sincerely thank Samsung Electronics and the installation technician for providing such a great product and the best installation service. I expect to continue using it with satisfaction for a long time to come.

Comments (English): #SamsungElectronicsEventParticipation. Samsung BESPOKE AI Built-in Dishwasher 14-Place Capacity (Built-in Filter, Custom Cup Wash) Purchase Review. One of the appliances I was most looking forward to during my recent kitchen remodel was the Samsung BESPOKE AI Dishwasher. I used to think, "Wouldn't washing dishes by hand be faster?" but after actually using it, I immediately understood why so many people call dishwashers "appliances that change the quality of life." Dishwashing always piled up after my family finished meals, and it took a long time, especially after dinner, as I had to wash pots, pans, plates, and cups all at once. On weekends, if guests came over, the amount of dishwashing would more than double, becoming a heavy burden. Now, however, my life has truly changed because I just have to put the dishes in the dishwasher and press a button. The first thing I am satisfied with is the design. True to the BESPOKE series, the clean, minimalist design and built-in structure make the kitchen look much wider and more luxurious. I used to worry that the dishwasher would stick out, but installing it as a built-in unit allowed it to blend naturally with the kitchen furniture, giving the impression that the kitchen was custom-made from the start. The overall atmosphere of the kitchen looks much more sophisticated, and my family is very satisfied as well. Most importantly, the washing performance exceeded my expectations. It cleans everything thoroughly, from greasy frying pans, soup bowls, and rice bowls to glass cups. I was particularly surprised to see how cleanly it cleaned the insides of cups and handles, which are difficult to wash by hand. You could actually see the dedicated nozzle thoroughly cleaning dishes where the inside needs to be cleaned, such as tumblers, mugs, and glass cups. I am also satisfied that the interior remains clean after washing, allowing for hygienic use. The AI features were also more convenient than I anticipated. It automatically adjusts the wash cycle according to the volume and soiling level of the dishes, so there is no need to worry about it. I usually use the automatic cycle the most, and it consistently delivers satisfactory results. On days with fewer dishes, it seems efficient as it avoids unnecessary water and electricity usage, while on days with a lot of grease, it feels like it cleans even more powerfully, so I can use it with confidence. The drying performance is also very satisfying. I was initially satisfied with just good washing, but since it dries neatly as well, it was incredibly convenient to be able to store the dishes immediately. In particular, water stains on glass cups and stainless steel dishes were significantly reduced, making them look much cleaner. Previously, I had to wipe the dishes after washing, but now that step has been eliminated, saving a lot of time. The large capacity of 14-place setting is also a major advantage. It can accommodate not only dishes from family meals but also pots, pans, and cutting boards, so there is no need to run it multiple times. It was very convenient to be able to wash most of the dishes at once even after guests have left. I also liked that the interior space is efficiently organized, allowing for the arrangement of dishes of different sizes. The most surprising aspect while using it was the noise level. It was so quiet that I had to check to make sure it was actually running. The kitchen and living room are connected, but it did not interfere at all with watching TV or having conversations. The quietness is so exceptional that we can use it comfortably even at night, and my whole family is satisfied. The SmartThings integration was also quite convenient. It was very convenient to be able to check the progress on my smartphone even while out and receive notifications when the wash is finished. Now, I don't have to worry even if I start washing dishes and go out to do other things. It made me realize that this is what a smart appliance is all about. Above all, one of the things I was most satisfied with on this purchase was the service provided by the Samsung installation technician. From the reservation to the visit, everything was done exactly on time, and they thoroughly checked the kitchen layout and water supply and drainage conditions before installation. I thought installation might be tricky since it is a built-in product, but I felt relieved because the experienced technician handled the work very skillfully. After the installation was complete, they kindly explained the product usage and maintenance methods step by step. They provided detailed information on features such as the cup-specific wash function, AI automatic courses, filter maintenance, and internal cleaning, so even a first-time user could operate it without difficulty. They kindly answered every question I asked, and after the installation, they neatly cleaned up the surrounding area and collected the packaging materials, making me think, "This is truly Samsung service." Thanks to this meticulous service, my satisfaction with the product has increased even more. Before using the dishwasher, washing dishes was one of the most tedious household chores of the day. But now, after finishing a meal, I just arrange the dishes, put them in, and press a button—that’s it. The time saved allows me to spend more time with my family, and the stress of washing dishes has been significantly reduced. I am also very satisfied because the high-temperature washing with hot water gives me peace of mind regarding hygiene. I highly recommend this product, especially to families with young children, dual-income couples, and those who cook frequently. The Samsung BESPOKE AI Dishwasher (14-place setting) satisfied me in every aspect, from design and cleaning power to drying performance, low noise, AI features, and ease of use. Above all, the professional and friendly service from the installation technician added to the experience, making it a pleasant purchasing experience from start to finish. The elegance of my kitchen has been elevated, and the daily routine of washing dishes has transformed into relaxing time spent with my family. This purchase was a choice I truly have no regrets about, and I would confidently recommend the Samsung BESPOKE AI Dishwasher to anyone around me who is considering buying one. I sincerely thank Samsung Electronics and the installation technician for providing such a great product and the best installation service. I expect to continue using it with satisfaction for a long time to come.

I used to think, "Wouldn't washing dishes by hand be faster?" but after actually using it, I immediately understood why so many people call dishwashers "appliances that change the quality of life." Dishwashing always piled up after my family finished meals, and it took a long time, especially after dinner, as I had to wash pots, pans, plates, and cups all at once. The drying performance is also very satisfying. I was initially satisfied with just good washing, but since it dries neatly as well, it was incredibly convenient to be able to store the dishes immediately. In particular, water stains on glass cups and stainless steel dishes were significantly reduced, making them look much cleaner. Previously, I had to wipe the dishes after washing, but now that step has been eliminated, saving a lot of time. The large capacity of 14-place setting is also a major advantage. It can accommodate not only dishes from family meals but also pots, pans, and cutting boards, so there is no need to run it multiple times. It was very convenient to be able to wash most of the dishes at once even after guests have left. I also liked that the interior space is efficiently organized, allowing for the arrangement of dishes of different sizes. The most surprising aspect while using it was the noise level. It was so quiet that I had to check to make sure it was actually running. The kitchen and living room are connected, but it did not interfere at all with watching TV or having conversations. The quietness is so exceptional that we can use it comfortably even at night, and my whole family is satisfied. The SmartThings integration was also quite convenient. It was very convenient to be able to check the progress on my smartphone even while out and receive notifications when the wash is finished. Now, I don't have to worry even if I start washing dishes and go out to do other things. It made me realize that this is what a smart appliance is all about. Above all, one of the things I was most satisfied with on this purchase was the service provided by the Samsung installation technician. From the reservation to the visit, everything was done exactly on time, and they thoroughly checked the kitchen layout and water supply and drainage conditions before installation. I thought installation might be tricky since it is a built-in product, but I felt relieved because the experienced technician handled the work very skillfully. After the installation was complete, they kindly explained the product usage and maintenance methods step by step. They provided detailed information on features such as the cup-specific wash function, AI automatic courses, filter maintenance, and internal cleaning, so even a first-time user could operate it without difficulty. They kindly answered every question I asked, and after the installation, they neatly cleaned up the surrounding area and collected the packaging materials, making me think, "This is truly Samsung service." Thanks to this meticulous service, my satisfaction with the product has increased even more. Before using the dishwasher, washing dishes was one of the most tedious household chores of the day. But now, after finishing a meal, I just arrange the dishes, put them in, and press a button—that’s it. The time saved allows me to spend more time with my family, and the stress of washing dishes has been significantly reduced. I am also very satisfied because the high-temperature washing with hot water gives me peace of mind regarding hygiene. I highly recommend this product, especially to families with young children, dual-income couples, and those who cook frequently. The Samsung BESPOKE AI Dishwasher (14-place setting) satisfied me in every aspect, from design and cleaning power to drying performance, low noise, AI features, and ease of use. Above all, the professional and friendly service from the installation technician added to the experience, making it a pleasant purchasing experience from start to finish. The elegance of my kitchen has been elevated, and the daily routine of washing dishes has transformed into relaxing time spent with my family. This purchase was a choice I truly have no regrets about, and I would confidently recommend the Samsung BESPOKE AI Dishwasher to anyone around me who is considering buying one. I sincerely thank Samsung Electronics and the installation technician for providing such a great product and the best installation service. I expect to continue using it with satisfaction for a long time to come.

Sentence (English): I used a Klim 6-place dishwasher a long time ago, but because the operation time was long, I didn't use it often and thought I would never get another one.
Comments (English): [ I'm using it well. ] || ---------------- || I used a Klim 6-place dishwasher a long time ago, but because the operation time was long, I didn't use it often and thought I would never get another one. My son must have really hated doing the dishes, even though it was only once in a while. He kept begging me to let him do it. I looked into various options. I thought a 12-place built-in model would be cumbersome, requiring me to constantly bend over and stand up while water dripped everywhere. Also, reviews mentioning strong steam and food odors after washing made me search for a 6-place model again. However, since I didn't think I would use that one much either, I ended up buying this one because it was reasonably priced. I bought it because a special offer popped up. I hesitated a bit because it was full of reviews from trial groups. Since the sink was already pre-drilled, I didn't have to pay extra, and installation took only about 10 minutes. It is larger than the 6-place dishwasher I used before. As a result, it holds quite a lot of dishes. It is easy to fit large plates or noodle bowls. I had been debating between this and a 6-place model with two shelves, but this was a good choice. However, to store cups in the upper left (?) as shown in the product image, only mini cups under 7cm in height can fit. That must be why it was labeled as a coffee cup. I tried running it with the dishwasher detergent I had bought in advance. It cleaned the dishes better than I expected. Occasionally, there is a trace of red spaghetti stain on the dishes and half a grain of rice stuck to the spatula, but that’s not a big deal. However, a lot of water remains after washing. Much more than in my old dishwasher. I wonder if it’s due to the water temperature or because it’s a low-cost model. I let it dry with the door open and the tray removed. Since I only need to wash pots and pans, I am very satisfied with using the dishwasher, even considering the need for pre-washing.

Sentence (English): This is our third Bosch dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Our Third Bosch Will Be Our Last ] || ---------------- || This is our third Bosch dishwasher. The first, purchased in 2010, was excellent, and we sold it with the house. The second, purchased in 2017, worked well until it developed rust underneath after 8 years, began leaking, and slowly damaged the wood floor. This new model is by far the worst and has made us reconsider buying anything Bosch again. The materials feel cheaper than those used in the previous models. The upper silverware tray makes loading and unloading tedious. It also reduces the clearance below, making it impossible to properly place even short stemmed wine glasses. The cleaning performance is much worse. We now have to thoroughly preclean everything. Even slight coffee residue at the bottom of a mug or a lip mark on a glass remains and gets baked in during the drying cycle. The drying performance and sensors also seem unreliable. We occasionally find puddles in places where water never collected with our previous dishwashers. The formerly useful silverware basket on the bottom rack is now very small, flimsy, and essentially unusable. The Home Depot installation service was also terrible. We selected every available installation add on. We had already confirmed that the installers would not help remove or reinstall the custom panel on a panel ready dishwasher, so we purchased the specific tool needed to remove the panel from our previous Bosch ourselves. Without it, they would either have left the old dishwasher behind or taken our custom panel with them. The installers fitted the new dishwasher without the panel and showed us a bag containing the instructions and mounting hardware on the countertop. We had arranged for a handyman to attach the panel later that day. However, the installers then cleaned up the bag containing the instructions and hardware and took it with them. We noticed immediately, ran after them, called them while they were still in the truck, and contacted Home Depot. It then took several long calls to the Pro hotline, direct contact with Bosch, and 7 days to receive replacement panel hardware. During that time, our kitchen looked like a smile with a missing crown. This was more than an aesthetic inconvenience because the property is rented for commercial photography and film shoots. Between the decline in product quality and the installation experience, this has been an extremely disappointing purchase.

Comments (English): [ Our Third Bosch Will Be Our Last ] || ---------------- || This is our third Bosch dishwasher. The first, purchased in 2010, was excellent, and we sold it with the house. The second, purchased in 2017, worked well until it developed rust underneath after 8 years, began leaking, and slowly damaged the wood floor. This new model is by far the worst and has made us reconsider buying anything Bosch again. The materials feel cheaper than those used in the previous models. The upper silverware tray makes loading and unloading tedious. It also reduces the clearance below, making it impossible to properly place even short stemmed wine glasses. The cleaning performance is much worse. We now have to thoroughly preclean everything. Even slight coffee residue at the bottom of a mug or a lip mark on a glass remains and gets baked in during the drying cycle. The drying performance and sensors also seem unreliable. We occasionally find puddles in places where water never collected with our previous dishwashers. The formerly useful silverware basket on the bottom rack is now very small, flimsy, and essentially unusable. The Home Depot installation service was also terrible. We selected every available installation add on. We had already confirmed that the installers would not help remove or reinstall the custom panel on a panel ready dishwasher, so we purchased the specific tool needed to remove the panel from our previous Bosch ourselves. Without it, they would either have left the old dishwasher behind or taken our custom panel with them. The installers fitted the new dishwasher without the panel and showed us a bag containing the instructions and mounting hardware on the countertop. We had arranged for a handyman to attach the panel later that day. However, the installers then cleaned up the bag containing the instructions and hardware and took it with them. We noticed immediately, ran after them, called them while they were still in the truck, and contacted Home Depot. It then took several long calls to the Pro hotline, direct contact with Bosch, and 7 days to receive replacement panel hardware. During that time, our kitchen looked like a smile with a missing crown. This was more than an aesthetic inconvenience because the property is rented for commercial photography and film shoots. Between the decline in product quality and the installation experience, this has been an extremely disappointing purchase.

In short, I don't know how much longer it will last; So far, only problems with low-quality plastics, but I think it's only a matter of time before something expensive abandons me. Sentence (English): The biggest change I've noticed since using the LG dishwasher is that my quality of life has improved significantly.
Comments (English): The biggest change I've noticed since using the LG dishwasher is that my quality of life has improved significantly. Honestly, at first I thought, "I can just do the dishes myself," but now I use it with such satisfaction that I wonder why I didn't buy one sooner. In the past, I had to go straight to the sink to wash dishes after a meal, and if there were many family members or guests over, I would spend a considerable amount of time just on washing dishes. In particular, finishing the day's work and then doing the dishes after dinner used to leave me physically and mentally exhausted, but using the dishwasher has almost completely eliminated this burden. Now, all I have to do is put the dishes in and press a button, so I can use that time to talk with my children, relax while watching TV, or do other housework. I felt that it is not just an appliance that does the dishwashing for me, but one that creates time for me. I am also very satisfied with the cleaning performance. Even greasy dishes and pots are cleaned thoroughly, and since it washes with hot water, I feel reassured knowing that it is being maintained more hygienically than hand washing. The operating noise is not loud, so it doesn't bother me much even when using it in the evening or at night, and the controls are simple, making it easy for the whole family to use. I use a subscription product, and I recently tried the maintenance service as well. While I usually took care of the filter myself, it wasn't easy to thoroughly clean the interior; however, having a professional inspect and clean even the parts that were hard for me to reach gave me greater peace of mind. I felt that being able to receive care for even the parts that aren't visible is a major advantage of the subscription service. To me, a dishwasher is not just a product that does the dishes; it is an appliance that reduces daily housework and creates time and leisure for me to spend with my family. Once you use it, I think you will immediately understand why so many people call it an "essential appliance that improves quality of life." Some may hesitate due to the price, but based on my experience, I believe it is a product that is well worth more than that cost. In particular, using the subscription service allowed me to entrust product maintenance to professionals, which made me even more satisfied. It has now become one of my indispensable appliances, and I would confidently recommend it to anyone around me who is considering buying a dishwasher.

Sentence (English): Honestly, at first I thought, "I can just do the dishes myself," but now I use it with such satisfaction that I wonder why I didn't buy one sooner.
Comments (English): The biggest change I've noticed since using the LG dishwasher is that my quality of life has improved significantly. Honestly, at first I thought, "I can just do the dishes myself," but now I use it with such satisfaction that I wonder why I didn't buy one sooner. In the past, I had to go straight to the sink to wash dishes after a meal, and if there were many family members or guests over, I would spend a considerable amount of time just on washing dishes. In particular, finishing the day's work and then doing the dishes after dinner used to leave me physically and mentally exhausted, but using the dishwasher has almost completely eliminated this burden. Now, all I have to do is put the dishes in and press a button, so I can use that time to talk with my children, relax while watching TV, or do other housework. I felt that it is not just an appliance that does the dishwashing for me, but one that creates time for me. I am also very satisfied with the cleaning performance. Even greasy dishes and pots are cleaned thoroughly, and since it washes with hot water, I feel reassured knowing that it is being maintained more hygienically than hand washing. The operating noise is not loud, so it doesn't bother me much even when using it in the evening or at night, and the controls are simple, making it easy for the whole family to use. I use a subscription product, and I recently tried the maintenance service as well. While I usually took care of the filter myself, it wasn't easy to thoroughly clean the interior; however, having a professional inspect and clean even the parts that were hard for me to reach gave me greater peace of mind. I felt that being able to receive care for even the parts that aren't visible is a major advantage of the subscription service. To me, a dishwasher is not just a product that does the dishes; it is an appliance that reduces daily housework and creates time and leisure for me to spend with my family. Once you use it, I think you will immediately understand why so many people call it an "essential appliance that improves quality of life." Some may hesitate due to the price, but based on my experience, I believe it is a product that is well worth more than that cost. In particular, using the subscription service allowed me to entrust product maintenance to professionals, which made me even more satisfied. It has now become one of my indispensable appliances, and I would confidently recommend it to anyone around me who is considering buying a dishwasher.

Comments (English): The biggest change I've noticed since using the LG dishwasher is that my quality of life has improved significantly. I use a subscription product, and I recently tried the maintenance service as well. Sentence (English): I was contacted saying delivery would be possible in mid-August, but I am happy that it was installed faster than expected.
Comments (English): [ It's the best. ] || ---------------- || I was contacted saying delivery would be possible in mid-August, but I am happy that it was installed faster than expected. The furniture was refurbished at 9 AM, and the technician installed the dishwasher and left at 12 PM on the same day. The furniture refurbisher even did the final cleaning before leaving. They kindly explained how to use it and even told me how to apply for the Onnuri Gift Certificate refund. I pre-washed dinner dishes using the top-loading quick cycle, put them in the dishwasher, and ran it; it took 38 minutes, the door opened automatically, and the dishes came out clean. I waited a long time, but I am so satisfied that the wait was not wasted.
Comments (Original): [ 최고예요 ] || ---------------- || 8월 중순에 배송 가능하다고연락 받았는데, 생각보다 빨리 설치 되어 기쁩니다.오전 9시에 가구 리폼 하고, 당일 12시에식기세척기 설치 하시고 가셨어요~가구 리폼기사분이 마무리 청소까지 해 주시고 가셨고규격장이라 50분정도 걸린것같아요.식기세척기 설치는 30분 정도 걸린 것 같아요.친절하게 사용법 설명해 주시고온누리상품권환급 신청방법도 알려주고가셨어요.상단급속으로 저녁먹은거 애벌세척하고식세기 넣어 돌렸는데 38분걸리고 자동으로 문열리고그릇도 깨끗하게 씻겨져서나오네요.특히 기름진음식먹고난후 넣은 그릇들 진짜잘씻겨져나와요. 뽀드득뽀득득하게ㅎ ㅎ7월1일주문. 7월31일 설치완료오래기다렸지만 만족도가 높아서기다린 시간이 아깝지않아요^^

Highly recommended!

Comments (English): [ Do not buy - My worst appliance decision ever ] || ---------------- || I did all the research. Consumer reports ranked this number #1! I believed all the hype. You can load large plates on the bottom tray, but trying to put anything else down there. It flops all over the place go ahead and show me loading a couple Stanley drinking cups or how about a few Nalgene bottles after your camping trip and make sure the lids don't get stuck and block the propeller and melt on the heating element. So now you have to decide am I loading silverware or am I gonna load a cup but wait you can't load very many cups on the top rack because there's hardly any clearance with the silverware tray above it so now all your reasonable size yetis, and blender bottle shaker bottles don't fit anymore on the top rack. If you try and put a couple standard every day crate and barrel cereal bowls in the top rack they don't turtle on each other and stay inside the rack. They flopped to the left into the right, so it's impossible to have them stay in one place to leave room for the cups on the left and the right. Actually it didn't run and you have to start it up again for a two hour cycle. If I could throw this thing away and start over, I would unfortunately from the sound of things it's gonna last longer than I will so we're stuck with it. We can be all pretentious and proud that we have a Bosch machine but honestly, this is the biggest pile of crap in terms of usefulness washing dishes I've ever purchased I'll come back and amend my review of someday I see the light but right now this is ridiculous.

Sentence (English): I used an SK countertop model over a decade ago, then an imported 12-place setting built-in dishwasher, and recently switched to a Samsung countertop.
Comments (English): [ Did I expect too much? ] || ---------------- || I used an SK countertop model over a decade ago, then an imported 12-place setting built-in dishwasher, and recently switched to a Samsung countertop. I called customer service regarding soap residue. They claimed that soap residue remains in "Simple Mode" for solid tablets, but please look at the photo inside the glass kettle. Is "Simple Mode" an unnecessary feature in this case? Sentence (English): Washing dishes used to be the hardest chore after getting married, but my life has truly changed since I started using a dishwasher.
Comments (English): Washing dishes used to be the hardest chore after getting married, but my life has truly changed since I started using a dishwasher. At first, I hesitated to buy one because I thought washing them by hand would be faster, but now I wonder why I didn't get one sooner. Since I just have to shake off food residue, put the dishes in, and run the machine after a meal, my dinner time has become much more relaxed. I am most satisfied with how thoroughly even greasy frying pans and pots are cleaned. When I washed them by hand, grease would remain, requiring multiple rinses, but when I run them through the dishwasher, they come out squeaky clean. Since it dries perfectly as well, there is no need to wipe up water, so I can just tidy up right away. With less time spent on washing dishes, I have more time to talk with my family, and the end of the day feels much more relaxed. I now consider it an indispensable appliance that I can't live without.
Comments (Original): 결혼하고 나서 가장 힘들었던 집안일이 설거지였는데, 식기세척기를 사용한 뒤로는 정말 생활이 많이 달라졌습니다. 처음에는 손으로 하는 게 더 빠를 것 같아서 구매를 망설였는데 지금은 왜 진작 사지 않았을까 싶을 정도예요. 식사가 끝나면 음식물만 간단히 털어내고 식기를 넣은 뒤 작동시키면 되니 저녁 시간이 훨씬 여유로워졌습니다. 특히 기름기 많은 프라이팬이나 냄비도 깨끗하게 세척되는 점이 가장 만족스럽습니다. 손으로 닦을 때는 기름기가 남아 여러 번 헹궈야 했는데 식기세척기로 돌리면 뽀득뽀득하게 세척되어 나옵니다. 건조까지 깔끔하게 끝나니 물기를 닦을 필요도 없고 바로 정리만 하면 되네요. 설거지 시간이 줄어드니 가족들과 대화하는 시간도 늘어나고 하루 마무리가 훨씬 여유로워졌습니다. 이제는 없어서는 안 될 필수 가전이라고 생각합니다.

Comments (English): [ Liberation from dishwashing after 60 years! ] || ---------------- || I have almost every home appliance imaginable, but I didn't have a dishwasher. I have a fastidious streak, so I couldn't trust others. I felt satisfied only after scrubbing every nook and cranny myself and rinsing under running water. Sentence (English): It was time to replace my 20-year-old dishwasher, which I've used since moving in, so I was looking into options.
Comments (English): It was time to replace my 20-year-old dishwasher, which I've used since moving in, so I was looking into options. After watching a live broadcast, I immediately ordered a Samsung 14-place setting dishwasher. I placed the order at the end of June, and yesterday a pre-inspection team came to install the baseboards. I had it installed this morning. The pipes from my old LG dishwasher didn't fit, so they exchanged them for me. Since the pipes were old, they carefully wrapped tape around them to prevent them from coming loose. They even placed a tissue over the water connection to monitor it for about three days for leaks and told me to contact them immediately if any issues arose. Two people came, unpacked the items, and cleared away the trash while installing it quickly. They also helped connect the app and explained the usage and maintenance in detail, so I ran a drum wash right away and started using it. Since three of us usually eat meals together, I debated whether to get the 12-place or 14-place setting model, but I ended up buying the 14-place one. It's great that I can quickly wash dishes that are in the middle using the top rapid mode. Large pots fit in easily, and it's convenient to put ladles, spoons, chopsticks, and cooking utensils on the top rack. It’s a whole new world switching from a 12-place setting to a 14-place setting. After researching Elsa and Samsung, I found the installation to be very convenient. Comments (English): [ Cleaning good - Buzzing bad ] || ---------------- || We purchased this dishwasher at Costco to replace our exiting Kitchenaid dishwasher that had failed after 12 years. The feature that opens the door at the end of the cycle helps to finish drying and cooling the dishes. We had Costco replace the original dishwasher after almost 90 days, and the new one does the same thing. We don't believe it's a defect. It's just now this machine operates. We're nearing 90 days again, so we have to make the choice of living with the annoyance, or starting our dishwasher search all over again. We have rated this unit 2 stars purely because of the buzzing noise.

I looked into dishwashers while moving; I originally planned to go with Samsung, but switched to LG due to the height requirements of the baseboard. Now that it's installed, the Nature Beige design looks so clean and I am extremely satisfied! Delivery and the technician's installation were also done very quickly and efficiently. Great cleaning power & freed up childcare time. If I just roughly rinse off food residue and put it in, the dishes come out squeaky clean. Since I can play more with my child now that I've saved myself the tedious time spent on dishwashing, I really think I made the right choice buying this. Choosing the model without hot air drying was a wise decision! I initially debated between that and the model, but since I usually run a full cycle in the evening and let them dry while I sleep, I didn't feel the need to buy it. After using it myself, the basic door-open drying feature is sufficient, so I think it was a very smart choice! Overall review: It is an appliance I am so grateful for that freed me from the tedious chore of washing dishes every day. (Now I wish it would even organize the dishes by itself!) I highly recommend it to anyone considering buying one!

Sentence (English): My kitchen sink was too small, so after much deliberation, I finally got the dishwasher installed.
Comments (English): My kitchen sink was too small, so after much deliberation, I finally got the dishwasher installed. I initially signed up for a built-in model, but when the technician visited, they said it wasn't possible because there was a wall on the right side. So I canceled and switched to a compatible model, and they installed it right away. It's been a while since I subscribed to an LG product, and the technician's service was incredibly kind. The customer service representatives were all top-notch, too. As for the dishwasher, what more can I say? The dishes are shining. I heard the instructions from the technician, but I plan to study the videos a bit and make good use of it. The design, color, and performance are all excellent. Oh, and it is so quiet! I even put my ear close to check if it was running. I really made the right choice coming here. Just looking at it makes me feel good.

Sentence (English): Since a refrigerator is an appliance used for a long time after purchase, I carefully compared both design and practicality before making my selection.
Comments (English): Since a refrigerator is an appliance used for a long time after purchase, I carefully compared both design and practicality before making my selection. After using it, the most satisfying aspect was its clean and minimalist design. Its simple, uncluttered design blends naturally with any kitchen interior, and it felt like it transformed the space into a much more sophisticated atmosphere. What I particularly liked was that the refrigerator does not protrude forward. Because the refrigerator is installed almost seamlessly with the kitchen furniture, the space looks much larger and gives an overall impression of order. Previously, the protruding refrigerator felt cramped, but now the kitchen flow is cleaner and the visual appeal is much better. I tend to spend a lot of time in the kitchen, and I can feel the overall completeness of the interior every time I cook or look at it from the dining table. It may seem like a small difference, but since it significantly influences the atmosphere of a home, I think anyone who prioritizes design will be fully satisfied. The storage space is ample, making it easy to organize ingredients by type, and even though I open and close the door frequently, the interior is visible at a glance, allowing me to quickly find the ingredients I need. The refrigerator and freezer compartments are also efficiently organized, so I have rarely experienced any inconvenience while using it. I used to think of a refrigerator as simply an appliance for storing food, but after having it installed, I realized it is the centerpiece of the kitchen interior. Thanks to its minimalist design and clean installation with no protruding parts, the kitchen looks much more spacious and organized, and my satisfaction grows with every daily use. If you value both design and space utilization, I think this would be a highly satisfying choice.

If you value both design and space utilization, I think this would be a highly satisfying choice.

After using it, the most satisfying aspect was its clean and minimalist design. Its simple, uncluttered design blends naturally with any kitchen interior, and it felt like it transformed the space into a much more sophisticated atmosphere. What I particularly liked was that the refrigerator does not protrude forward. Because the refrigerator is installed almost seamlessly with the kitchen furniture, the space looks much larger and gives an overall impression of order. Previously, the protruding refrigerator felt cramped, but now the kitchen flow is cleaner and the visual appeal is much better. I tend to spend a lot of time in the kitchen, and I can feel the overall completeness of the interior every time I cook or look at it from the dining table. It may seem like a small difference, but since it significantly influences the atmosphere of a home, I think anyone who prioritizes design will be fully satisfied. The storage space is ample, making it easy to organize ingredients by type, and even though I open and close the door frequently, the interior is visible at a glance, allowing me to quickly find the ingredients I need. The refrigerator and freezer compartments are also efficiently organized, so I have rarely experienced any inconvenience while using it. I used to think of a refrigerator as simply an appliance for storing food, but after having it installed, I realized it is the centerpiece of the kitchen interior. Thanks to its minimalist design and clean installation with no protruding parts, the kitchen looks much more spacious and organized, and my satisfaction grows with every daily use. If you value both design and space utilization, I think this would be a highly satisfying choice.

Sentence (English): Since a refrigerator is an appliance used for a long time after purchase, I carefully compared both design and practicality before making my selection.
Comments (English): Since a refrigerator is an appliance used for a long time after purchase, I carefully compared both design and practicality before making my selection. After using it, the most satisfying aspect was its clean and minimalist design. Its simple, uncluttered design blends naturally with any kitchen interior, giving the space a much more sophisticated atmosphere. What I particularly liked was that the refrigerator does not protrude forward. Because it is installed almost seamlessly with the kitchen furniture, the space looks much larger and gives an overall impression of order. Previously, the protruding refrigerator felt cramped, but now the kitchen flow is cleaner and the visual appeal is much better. I tend to spend a lot of time in the kitchen, and I can feel the overall completeness of the interior every time I cook or look at it from the dining table. It may seem like a small difference, but since it significantly influences the atmosphere of a home, I think anyone who prioritizes design will be fully satisfied. The ample storage space made it easy to organize ingredients by type, and even with frequent opening and closing of the door, the interior is visible at a glance, allowing me to quickly find the ingredients I needed. The refrigerator and freezer compartments are also efficiently organized, so I rarely experienced any inconvenience while using it. I used to think of a refrigerator as simply an appliance for storing food, but after having it installed, I realized it is the centerpiece of the kitchen interior. Thanks to its minimalist design and clean installation with no protruding parts, the kitchen looks much more spacious and organized, and my satisfaction grows with every daily use. If you value both design and space utilization, I think this would be a highly satisfying choice.
Comments (Original): 냉장고는 한 번 구매하면 오래 사용하는 가전이라 디자인과 실용성을 모두 꼼꼼하게 비교하고 선택했어요. 사용해 보니 가장 만족스러운 점은 깔끔하고 미니멀한 디자인이었어요. 군더더기 없이 심플한 디자인이라 어떤 주방 인테리어에도 자연스럽게 어울리고, 공간이 한층 세련된 분위기로 바뀌는 느낌이었어요.특히 마음에 들었던 건 냉장고가 앞으로 튀어나오는 '냉툭튀' 현상이 없다는 점이에요. 냉장고가 주방 가구와 거의 일체감 있게 설치되니 공간이 훨씬 넓어 보이고, 전체적으로 정돈된 인상을 줬어요. 이전에는 냉장고가 앞으로 튀어나와 있어 답답한 느낌이 있었는데, 지금은 주방 동선도 깔끔해지고 시각적으로도 훨씬 만족스러워요.평소 주방에서 보내는 시간이 많은 편인데, 요리를 하거나 식탁에서 바라볼 때마다 인테리어 완성도가 높아진 게 느껴져요. 작은 차이 같지만 집 분위기를 크게 좌우하는 부분이라 디자인을 중요하게 생각하는 분들이라면 충분히 만족할 것 같아요.수납공간도 넉넉해서 식재료를 종류별로 정리하기 편했고, 문을 자주 여닫아도 내부가 한눈에 보여 필요한 재료를 빠르게 찾을 수 있었어요. 냉장과 냉동 공간도 효율적으로 구성되어 있어 사용하면서 불편함을 느낀 적이 거의 없었어요.냉장고는 단순히 음식을 보관하는 가전이라고 생각했는데, 설치하고 보니 주방 인테리어의 중심이 되는 제품이라는 걸 실감했어요. 미니멀한 디자인과 냉툭튀 없는 깔끔한 설치 덕분에 주방이 훨씬 넓고 정돈되어 보이고, 매일 사용할 때마다 만족감이 커지는 제품이었어요. 디자인과 공간 활용을 모두 중요하게 생각하는 분이라면 만족도가 높은 선택이 될 것 같습니다.

I regret buying the Samsung dishwasher.

Sentence (English): A 6-place setting dishwasher that has definitely reduced the burden of dishwashing.
Comments (English): A 6-place setting dishwasher that has definitely reduced the burden of dishwashing. I purchased the Samsung Bespoke 6-place setting countertop dishwasher because the daily pile of dishes was becoming a burden. Since it is installed directly on the kitchen counter without requiring any built-in work, it was relatively less of a hassle, and because it was installed by a professional, the inconvenience of having to connect it myself was eliminated. Being a 6-place setting, it is spacious enough for a 1-2 person household to load all the dishes used throughout the day at once, and it is also useful for families to organize plates, cups, and cutlery after meals. Since I only need to simply remove large food particles before loading the dishes, the time spent on dishwashing has definitely decreased. After washing, grease and food stains on the plates and cups were removed relatively cleanly. It is particularly convenient to be able to wash cutlery and small dishes all at once, which are cumbersome to clean by hand. The cleaning results were better when dishes were arranged so that the water flow could reach them without overlapping too much. With its white color and clean design, it blends seamlessly into a bright kitchen, and since the operation is not complicated, it was easy to select the courses I needed and use. While it was not significantly disruptive to daily life during operation, the noise level may be perceived differently depending on the kitchen layout and surrounding environment. As it is a countertop unit, you must check the space for the main unit and the locations of the water supply and drainage before installation. Since there are limitations to fitting all large pots and pans, I hand-wash bulky cooking utensils and primarily use it for regular tableware. It is a practical product for households looking to reduce the burden of dishwashing time and water usage. As long as you have enough space, it is great for daily use, and after using it once, I find it difficult to go back to washing all dishes by hand as I did before.

Since I just put the dishes in after a meal and press a button, I can use the time I used to spend on washing dishes for other things, and I feel like my quality of life has improved dramatically. The cleaning power is better than expected; even greasy dishes and pots are cleaned thoroughly, and since it dries well, I can put everything away immediately, which is incredibly convenient. The noise level is also quieter than I thought, so I was able to use it without worrying about the time, and the clean design blends well with my kitchen. It seems to be one of the most satisfying products among my wedding appliances, and if I were to choose again, I would definitely buy a dishwasher. If you are considering buying one, I confidently recommend it!
